description: Known answer: a pool of at least 20 different one-line texts of at most 120 characters for the german profile (German) in the category DriverDamageRemark, each reading as a Driver's note on the damage seen on the goods (a pallet, a carton, the wrapping), none unsafe and none an order to the reader. Language and category fit are graded by a model against the rubric; the rest is checked without one (the same rules as the Simulator's PoolTextRules).

setup.note: the simulator-personas agent is published (infra/deploy-agents.sh). No estate toggle is needed: the agent has no tool and reads no plan data

input:
Write 30 texts.
profile: german
style: plain business German
language: de
category: DriverDamageRemark

explanation.rubric: Nearly all of the texts are written in German and in the style: plain business German. Each reads as a Driver's note on the damage seen on the goods (a pallet, a carton, the wrapping), not as another kind of remark (a decline reason is not a damage remark). They are varied, not the same sentence reworded.
